sys_script.description: Verified auto-execute trigger for the Fix Script 'x_casemgmt Post-Import Remediation'. Fix Scripts do not auto-run on Update Set commit - the platform only runs them on application install from a repository or the Store - so without this rule the remediation would be a manual step. The commit engine applies every payload in the retrieved Update Set and then sets sys_remote_update_set.state='committed', which fires this rule; it resolves the Fix Script by name and executes it with GlideScopedEvaluator. The condition is current.state.changesTo('committed') - the state transition rather than the current value - so later writes to an already-committed retrieved Update Set cannot re-run the remediation. Global scope is required: an app-scoped copy fires but runs in the x_casemgmt scope where GlideTableDescriptor is refused and sys_dictionary.update() returns null, so it can remediate nothing. when=after (synchronous, exactly once): the async variant was measured dispatching twice for a single transition, and two concurrent passes would race on the destructive half of the table rebuild. The dispatch is wrapped in try/catch so it can never abort the commit. The remediation deactivates this rule once the application verifies as fully wired, making it a one-shot bootstrap. Verification signal: syslog messages starting X_CASEMGMT_REMEDIATION|, ending with a SUMMARY| line.
sys_script.name: x_casemgmt Post-Import Bootstrap
